lead: America's creative industries have lost 200,000 jobs in four years with no recession to blame, and a blogger writes the field guide for sites that want AI agents as readers.

sections.title: Creative work under the machine
sections.intro: Apricitas counts 200,000 US creative-industry jobs lost in four years - recession-grade losses with no recession - and asks how much of it is AI.

sections.title: Websites learn to talk to agents
sections.intro: A static-blog author ships a full recipe for agent-readable publishing: markdown mirrors, content negotiation, llms.txt and explicit crawler signals.
